description.zh: 物理库ID：可通过调用接口[ListDatabases](~~141873~~)或[SearchDatabase](~~141876~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of a physical database: You can call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) or [SearchDatabase](~~141876~~) operation to obtain the physical database ID.

description.zh:
表名。
>您可以通过调用接口[ListTables](~~141878~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en:
The table name.

>  You can also call the [ListTables](~~141878~~) operation to query the table name.

description.zh: 表模式名，仅当SQLServer需要传递为架构名。
description.en: The schema name of the table, which is required only for SQL Server instances.

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)或[ListUserTenants](~~198074~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The tenant ID. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.
